title: Singapore for Couples with Adventure Cove
alt: Marina Bay Sands and the Singapore skyline seen across the water at dusk
transport: Private airport transfers with shared coaches for tours and tickets

expert.name: Nisha Rao
expert.quote: Five nights in one good hotel, no packing and unpacking, and a different side of the city every day. Couples like that rhythm.
expert.tip: Keep the Adventure Cove day for last. After two theme park days you will want the lazy river more than another queue.

summary: Six days in the city for two. A wildlife evening at Mandai, the skyline from level 57, Gardens by the Bay, a full day at Universal Studios, Sentosa by cable car with the oceanarium and Wings of Time, then the water park at Adventure Cove.
included: Included: 5 nights at the One Farrer Hotel with daily breakfast; Night Safari with tram ride; half day city tour; Marina Bay Sands SkyPark; the Gardens by the Bay domes with the Jurassic World trail; Universal Studios one day pass; two way cable car sky pass; Singapore Oceanarium; Wings of Time; Adventure Cove Waterpark; 10 private and shared transfers.
not_included: Not included: international flights; visa charges; travel insurance; lunches and dinners; attractions not named above; personal expenses.

day_titles.2: City tour, SkyPark and the Gardens
day_titles.4: Sentosa, oceanarium and Wings of Time

1: Arrival at Changi Airport and private sedan transfer to the One Farrer Hotel
Check in to your super deluxe room and take the afternoon slowly
Shared transfer to Mandai for the Night Safari and its tram circuit
Nocturnal walking trails afterwards if you still have the energy
2: Breakfast, then shared transfer for the half day city tour
Merlion Park, the Helix bridge, Chinatown and the civic district
Marina Bay Sands SkyPark on level 57 above the bay
Cloud Forest, Flower Dome and Jurassic World at Gardens by the Bay
3: Breakfast, then shared transfer to Resorts World Sentosa
One day pass for Universal Studios across all seven zones
Lunch inside the park and the stunt show in the afternoon
Evening free along the Sentosa boardwalk
4: Breakfast, then shared transfer to Mount Faber for the cable car
Two way sky pass over the harbour to Sentosa
Singapore Oceanarium with its open ocean tank and reef galleries
Wings of Time on Siloso beach once it is dark
5: Breakfast, then shared transfer back across to Sentosa
A full day at Adventure Cove with the lazy river and the slides
Snorkel with the rays at Rainbow Reef, gear provided at the park
Quiet evening in Little India near the hotel
6: Breakfast and a late check out where possible
Private sedan transfer to Changi Airport for your flight home

stops.name: Singapore
stops.accom: 5 nights · Breakfast included · Super deluxe room · 4★ · One Farrer Hotel with a garden pool, beside Farrer Park MRT and Little India

program.name: One base, six different days
program.description: Five nights at Farrer Park with wildlife, the skyline, two theme parks and a water park all inside half an hour on the MRT.

activities.name: Night Safari with Tram Ride
activities.description: A tram circuit through the Mandai park after dark, past elephants, rhinos, hyenas and the big cats.

activities.name: Half Day Singapore City Tour
activities.description: A shared coach tour of Merlion Park, Marina Bay, the Helix bridge, Chinatown and the colonial quarter.

activities.name: Marina Bay Sands SkyPark
activities.description: The level 57 observation deck above Marina Bay, the Gardens and the towers of the business district.

activities.name: Gardens by the Bay
activities.description: Cloud Forest with its indoor waterfall, the Flower Dome and the Jurassic World trail among the Supertrees.

activities.name: Universal Studios Singapore
activities.description: A one day pass covering Sci Fi City, Ancient Egypt, Far Far Away and the Hollywood boulevard shows.

activities.name: Singapore Cable Car Sky Pass
activities.description: A two way ride from Mount Faber over HarbourFront to Sentosa, with the container port below.

activities.name: Singapore Oceanarium
activities.description: Sentosa's rebuilt aquarium with an open ocean tank, reef habitats and a research gallery.

activities.name: Wings of Time
activities.description: A twenty minute beachfront show of water screens, lasers and fire, staged on Siloso beach.

activities.name: Adventure Cove Waterpark
activities.description: Slides, a lazy river and a snorkel reef with rays and thousands of fish, all on the Sentosa waterfront.

activities.name: Singapore River Cruise
activities.description: A bumboat along the quays past the old shophouses and warehouses, at its best after sunset.
